text:
Maya: FYI did a short-tail holdout run for probebird-v1. baseline recall@10=0.88, after switching to L2 normalize at query-time recall@10=0.72.
Oliver: wow that's large. cosine vs dot?
Maya: L2+cosine=0.72, raw dot (no norm)=0.86 on same holdout.
Sophie: paste eval command+seedset please.
Maya: `python eval/recall.py --model probebird-v1 --holdout holdout_shorttail.jsonl --seedset data/seed_shorttail.jsonl --postproc l2 --k 10 --metric cosine`
Liam: hypotheses: model mean drift or postproc/inventory mismatch (ingest vs query). Also duplicates in seedset can amplify this.
Evan: quant might amplify too. was that fp16?
Maya: fp16. queued int6 run. infra-bot: job 62245 queued (int6) ETA ~20m.
Oliver: check recall@1 and median rank.
Maya: recall@1 0.61 -> 0.45, median rank 3 -> 12. Head shift for sure.
Sophie: plan: expA no postproc; expB l2 then batch-whiten; expC int6 vs fp16. Also re-index small shard with each postproc to ensure parity.
Liam: re-indexing 50k shard now.
Evan: int6 finished: recall@10=0.69 (artifact linked).
Sophie: whitened+reindex gives recall@10=0.85, recall@1=0.58. looks like centering helps.
Oliver: add mean-subtraction to onboarding checks and ensure ingest/query postproc parity.
Maya: agreed 5 will update ML-8763 with artifacts and a short PR for eval scripts. :thumbsup:
